full_judgment:
Mohammad Abdur Rouf, J.- This petition for leave by the informant-petitioner is from the judgment and order dated 2.1.96 of a Division bench of the High Court Division passed in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1505 of 1995 quashing the proceeding taken against respondent No. 1 in G. R. Case No. 1857 of 1994 of the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code arising out of Motijheel P.S. Case No. 4 dated 2.7.94. 

 3. On 11.3.95 the Magistrate framed charge under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code against respondent No. 1. Then respondent No. 1 moved the High Court Division under section 561A Cr. P.C. for quashing the proceeding and a Division bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order quashed the proceeding of the aforesaid G.R. Case making the Rule absolute.
